title: Spinach, asparagus and new potato hash

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is whole food: potatoes, asparagus, spring onions, spinach, eggs, Greek yoghurt, oil and spices.

supermarket.reason: Every item is a Tesco staple, and British asparagus is at its cheapest in late May.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a large lidded frying pan and simple frying, so it suits a confident beginner.

works.reason: Covering the halved new potatoes for 15 minutes, then frying for 5 more, should make them tender, and the quantities of spinach, asparagus and eggs suit four.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is believable for halving potatoes and slicing asparagus, spring onions and chives, and the steps add up to roughly the 25 minutes of cooking printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the chives and smoked paprika, appears in the steps, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm hash of spinach, asparagus and new potatoes suits late May, and the 200g of spinach is a real component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, two green vegetables, eggs and yoghurt make a balanced, filling breakfast a family would want again.
